verdicts.reason: A crams everything into the top 55% and leaves the bottom ~45% of the canvas empty. The circle has shrunk and sits on the bottle cap like a balloon, "WEEKEND ONLY" is jammed against the top edge, and the body copy wraps into a narrow column with an orphaned "sparkling." B uses the tall format properly with a clear headline → product → CTA order and a large CTA. Its flaws: "WEEKEND ONLY" has moved below the body copy, so the eyebrow is out of order; the headline overlaps the decorative circle; and the bottle sits a little tight on the copy above it.
